headline: PM Tarique Rahman attends Trump’s dinner for world leaders in New York
summary: The Prime Minister and Dr Zubaida Rahman joined heads of state and government for an event hosted by US President Donald Trump at the Lotte New York Palace hotel.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and his wife, Dr Zubaida Rahman, attended a dinner hosted by US President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump for world leaders.
The event took place on Tuesday night at the luxury Lotte New York Palace hotel in New York City.
The dinner was attended by heads of state and government of UN member states and their spouses.
Earlier that morning, the Prime Minister and Dr Zubaida Rahman also attended a breakfast hosted by UN Secretary-General António Guterres.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is currently in New York to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).
The Prime Minister is scheduled to deliver his maiden address to the global body on Thursday.

headline_marked: Woman [[killed by DNCC garbage truck]] in Dhaka's Korail
headline: Woman killed by DNCC garbage truck in Dhaka's Korail
summary: Meherun Begum, 50, was run over by the vehicle's rear wheel while collecting scrap materials in the Mohakhali area.
details: A 50-year-old woman was killed after being run over by a Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) garbage truck in the Korail area of Dhaka on Tuesday evening.
The deceased has been identified as Meherun Begum, originally from Sherpur in Mymensingh.
The accident occurred beside the T&T field in the Beltala area of the Korail slum in Mohakhali, according to Mehedi Hasan, officer-in-charge of Banani Police Station.
Meherun used to collect recyclable materials from the city corporation's secondary transfer station (STS).
Police stated that she was run over by the rear wheel of the truck while collecting scrap materials as usual.
The officer noted that Meherun had hearing difficulties and could not hear the truck's horn, leading to the accident.
She was rescued and taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared her dead.
Meherun's husband, Badsha, is a van driver, and the couple lived in a rented house near the T&T field in Mohakhali.
